stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $519 \times 51$ is divided by $17$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $519 \equiv 9$ and $51 \equiv 0 \pmod{17}$. So the product is $\equiv 9 \times 0 = 0 \equiv 0 \pmod{17}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
